europe_now.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italy over Ceuta dispute
europe_now.summary: Spain has implemented border checks on Italian travelers amid a growing migration dispute between EU countries. The measures aim to address concerns over unauthorized crossings at the Ceuta border.

sources.headline: Spain starts border checks on Italy over Ceuta dispute

europe_now.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange deadly overnight strikes
europe_now.summary: Russian and Ukrainian forces conducted overnight missile strikes, resulting in casualties and destruction of infrastructure. Ukraine denies targeting Bulgaria after a drone incident near a gas pipeline.

sources.headline: Russia and Ukraine exchange deadly overnight strikes

top_stories.title: Ceuta border dispute escalates between Spain and Italy
